move: cursor tours components: hover, press, load, type, tab, like, dropdown
how: Three columns of light UI (buttons, input, tabs, chips, card, dropdown) slide up with a 0.1s expo.out stagger. A cursor then visits them in order over 6s: the primary button lifts y -3 with a shadow, presses to scale .96 and recovers elastic (15-30%); the Submit button presses, its label fades, a spinner rotates 1080deg linearly for 1.3s, then it turns green and Done pops in with back.out(2) (32-63%); the input gets a blue focus ring, the floating label shrinks up (y -38, scale .78, back.out), a caret blinks and TextPlugin types an email over 0.9s before a green tick scales in (42-63%); the tab underline slides x 110 then 200 with power3.inOut; chips fill black one by one with a 0.3s stagger and a small scale pop; the heart presses, springs elastic and fills red (75%); the dropdown chevron flips 180, the menu scales open with back.out(1.8), a row highlights, the label swaps to Pro and it closes (84-93%). The board fades at 96%.
adapt: Replace every label, the typed email, tab and chip names, the card image gradient and the accent blue/green/red; drop components you do not need and rebalance the cursor visits; keep the 0.1s press, elastic recovery and 0.35s menu open.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the board and cursor from shot.components; animate returns the timeline with each visit placed at fractions of D (button 0.15D, loader 0.32D, input 0.42D, heart 0.75D, dropdown 0.84D). Cursor x/y are stage-absolute and must be derived from el; scope selectors to el and register TextPlugin.
caveats: set() calls toggle display on the spinner, so seeking backwards relies on GSAP recording the prior value
